title: Constrained host route completion and process-origin proof

userAuthorization.source: Explicit approval in the current task attachment: accept the clarified Moirae constrained-host architecture and prepare and activate bounded FATES-SLICE-003A.
userAuthorization.scope: Prepare and activate only the bounded 003A process-origin and constrained route completion work. Do not start 003B, change Runtime Contracts, advance compatibility state, modify Slice 02 lock/matrix/snapshot/seal evidence, or perform formal live acceptance before the owner-review gate.

lineagePreservation.rule: The documentation/design lineage and the new uncommitted implementation must not be represented as the locked compatibility checkpoint or as a sealed component state.

approvedScope.topology: Independent Moirae process -> Horae /slice-02/governed-actions -> canonical Ananke /api/execute -> Horae -> Moirae
approvedScope.changedFate: Moirae Code only for the smallest host/origin boundary; Horae and Ananke are sealed consumers/producers and remain unchanged unless a genuine blocker is found.
approvedScope.integrationRole: Evidence and control-state owner; no fixture access and no route implementation.
approvedScope.transport: The existing bounded loopback HTTP route through Horae only; no alternate MCP or direct Ananke path.
approvedImplementationShape: Allowlisted launch configuration supplies the Moirae instance and artifact identity; request construction is fixed to the approved action and route.
The Moirae request carries process-origin evidence, origin digest, request/correlation identifiers, bounded host context, and the exact fixed-fixture arguments.
The host performs one Horae request with a bounded timeout, accepts a typed route result, and fails closed on transport, malformed, drifted, or non-object responses.
No credentials, arbitrary action input, fixture read, direct Ananke URL, retry, fallback, duplicate dispatch, OS containment, or generic host service is introduced.
excluded: Credential custody, brokerage, secret or environment isolation, and bypass claims
Generic governed actions, arbitrary filesystem access, direct Moirae-to-Ananke access, alternate MCP transports, retry, persistence, idempotency, reconciliation, and recovery
Mnemosyne memory/context retrieval or memory authority
Runtime Contracts package, protocol, or schema changes
Compatibility lock, matrix, snapshot, tag, or seal advancement
Formal live acceptance in this owner-local implementation pass

acceptanceCriteria: An independently running Moirae process is the request origin.
Process-origin evidence is tied to the request and includes the request/correlation relationship.
The intended route reaches Horae first; Moirae has no direct Ananke execution path.
Horae performs fresh origin, identity, endpoint, readiness, producer, capability, and protocol checks before dispatch.
The dispatch uses the exact canonical Ananke endpoint and the sealed Slice 02 action authority.
Exactly one harmless producer-owned fixed-fixture read/effect is attempted on the positive path.
There is no retry after transport failure or post-dispatch uncertainty.
There is no fallback or alternate endpoint.
There is no duplicate dispatch or duplicate physical read.
There is no fixture, filesystem, mock, or alternate route used as a substitute for the canonical path.
Route, event, request, and correlation identifiers plus producer/effect evidence are preserved.
The Moirae result is typed and retains the relay state and evidence boundary.
Malformed requests and malformed responses fail closed.
Origin identity or origin-digest drift fails closed.
Horae endpoint, instance, readiness, producer, capability, or protocol drift fails closed.
Ananke denial is returned as a typed denial without an alternate execution path.
Timeout preserves uncertainty and does not imply success or retry.
Indeterminate post-dispatch transport loss preserves uncertainty and does not retry.
Deterministic tests cover malformed, origin, drift, denial, timeout, indeterminate, no-retry, and duplicate cases.
The process stops cleanly, temporary evidence stays outside repositories, and no credentials or local configuration are committed.

ownerResponsibilities.moiraeCode: Implement and test only the constrained host/origin boundary, Horae-only route initiation, typed relay result, bounded timeout, and explicit limitations.
ownerResponsibilities.horae: Validate the host request against the existing sealed Slice 02 relay and run relevant consumer checks; stop on any contract or sealed-behavior blocker.
ownerResponsibilities.ananke: Remain the sole authority/effect owner and run relevant consumer checks against the existing sealed producer; no implementation change is authorized.
ownerResponsibilities.integration: Record activation and evidence requirements, validate canonical control state, run Integration checks and later real proof, and preserve all Slice 02 lock/matrix/snapshot/seal artifacts.
ownerResponsibilities.mnemosyne: Remain outside the route and unchanged.
ownerResponsibilities.runtimeContracts: Remain unchanged and authoritative for the existing shared contract baseline.

implementationOrder: Activate the Integration control record and preserve the Slice 02 baseline.
Complete the smallest Moirae host/origin boundary and deterministic tests.
Run focused and relevant Horae and Ananke validation against sealed checkpoints.
Run Integration canonical, lock, matrix, slice, boundary, and 003A checks.
Stop for owner review before formal live acceptance.
postActivationRequirements: Moirae focused tests, build, lint, format check, and relevant suite pass.
